notes: Thumb test has two resident shapes but only one weapon-specific shape active.
Changing test alternates the driver rotation and includes that Transform write plus SetBlendShapeWeight.
Wrist and thumb timings are separate microbenchmarks, not a combined frame-time or FPS measurement.
GPU skinning, blend-shape evaluation, initial mesh preparation and full-game frame cost are not measured.
No per-frame CPU mesh-vertex edits, physics simulation or runtime IK were added.
